# Governance

Right now, this is a solo org.

Being a fork organization adds one rule worth stating: **we do not govern the projects we
fork.** Upstream owns the original — its direction, its releases, its licence. What gets
decided here is narrow: whether to carry a fork at all, what goes into our own changes, and
when to retire a fork because upstream has caught up.

Retiring is the intended ending. A fork whose changes have landed upstream should be archived
with a pointer to the original, not kept alive out of habit.
